name: Blue Widow
summary: **Blue Widow** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] crossing [[blueberry|Blueberry]] and [[white-widow|White Widow]]. It pairs Blueberry's 1970s DJ Short line with White Widow, bred by Green House Seed Co. in the 1990s, though the breeder who first combined the two is not documented.
